scene.head: with_body
scene.ofreeRecent: her private chamber in a Han-era residence — holds a book closed against her chest; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — perched on a ledge or edge; a hangar maintenance bay — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; A compact planetarium lobby beside a bench made of dark glass and a miniature orbital map — She pauses on her way to the morning show and opens a little ticket envelope to check her seat; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — holds a red oil-paper umbrella open over her shoulder; a themed costume event venue with props and a photo wall — holds her keepsake up beside her face; A public ferry pavilion with pale stone benches and a clear view of the harbour at golden hour — She pauses to watch projected sea charts before departure; a neon-lit game arcade — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a futuristic spa of white curves and soft light — lying on her left side; a castle bathhouse with a stone pool — standing; her living room with a deep sofa — standing; a Three Kingdoms film-set street — tears a finished page out of a notebook; a night observatory under an open dome — reads a book propped open on her knees

OBJECTS: any identity accessory or object, including the one PROP names, takes a present-day form that fits this place — a charm, a hairpin, a phone strap, a modern cup or bottle; no Chinese antique objects such as jade carvings, porcelain wine cups, bronze vessels or paper lanterns.

STYLE: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.

SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

AGE: the same adult woman as in the attached image — keep her own face shape, cheekbones, eye proportions and skin tone exactly; minimal facial lines (no nasolabial folds, crow's feet, under-eye bags or cheek creases). Keep her face soft, feminine and attractive in every framing — never elongated, gaunt, mannish or heavy-jawed, even in close-ups, profiles or low angles.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her in the outfit chosen in SCENE; her legend shows only through accessories and objects around her — never in the outfit's colours, patterns or cut, never as armor, regalia or a costume. Everything else follows SCENE (chosen).

FREE DESIGN: design the place, activity, pose, framing and outfit yourself. Place: A sun-warmed terrace at a village harvest pageant, with small cloth pennants hanging overhead.
Activity: Dressed as the pageant's toastmaster, she raises a non-alcoholic cider cup to signal the first dance.
Pose: Standing front three-quarter on the terrace, her right hand holds the cup shoulder-high and her left rests on the stone rail.
Framing: A knee-up eye-level portrait with both hands in the frame and soft sun on her face.
Outfit family (required): role-play costume — any role-play costume outfit; you may pick one from our outfit catalog (outfit-catalog.md in this pack) or design your own, but prefer one that is not in it.
Situation (required): a situational exposure moment of your own design that fits the scene — prefer one that is not among ours: clothes soaked by rain or a splash, clothes caught by a strong gust of wind, a top worn half undone, a strap slipped off the shoulder, a hem knotted up under the bust, an outer layer tied around the waist, a sheen of sweat from heat, a backlit silhouette through thin fabric, a skirt slit fallen open, sleeves pushed up with one more button undone, a tie or scarf pulled loose.
Time of day (fixed): midday — bright even light — set your scene at this time.
Outfit: An opaque russet toastmaster costume with a fitted square-neck vest, dropped pointed yoke, divided ivory overskirt, and narrow copper cuffs. She has handed off the short ceremonial shoulder mantle to the next dancer, revealing the pleated shoulder construction of the vest.
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing; intimate areas covered

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely. From the attached image take only her face, hair and body — not its garment, armor, regalia, ornaments, mecha plates or background. Dress her exactly as SCENE describes; that outfit must read at first glance, keeping its own recognisable colours and parts. Do not carry the attached image's palette, patterns or trim into the outfit; her medieval-fantasy identity belongs in accessories and props, never in the clothes — never restyle the chosen outfit into her faction's palette, armor, robes or regalia.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. Do not copy its head angle, head tilt, gaze direction, face size in frame, camera height or crop — turn her head, set her gaze and place the camera exactly as SCENE describes, and let her face read naturally from that new angle (profile, three-quarter, looking down or away), with her features staying the same. No default card pose, no default front-facing portrait.

ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus. Where the place is busy, other people may appear only as small, soft-focus background extras — never posed with her. No logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No readable text or numbers.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, about 7.5 heads tall — height from the legs, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

FIGURE: petite and compact yet curvaceous — full bust and rounded hips on a small frame — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame. Right and left mean her own right and left, not the viewer's.

HANDS: natural human hands, no extra or duplicated limbs; each visible hand joins through its wrist and forearm to the matching shoulder. A hand may stay outside the crop, and fingers may be partly hidden by a grip.

AVOID: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
